name: Bekee maka Ebe Ọrụ (ESL)
objectives: N'ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ, ịza ajụjụ ndị a na-ajụkarị dị ka "Tell me about yourself" site n'azịza dị mkpụmkpụ i doziri tupu oge, n'ahịrịokwu 2 ruo 4 doro anya nke ọ bụla, ya na otu ezi ọmụmaatụ site n'ọrụ gị ma ọ bụ ndụ gị

Mgbe e nyere gị okwu nchekwa, akara na ịdọ aka na ntị a na-ahụkarị n'ebe ọrụ, ikwu ihe nke ọ bụla pụtara na ihe ị ga-eme, ma kọọrọ onye isi ọrụ ihe egwu ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ, ma nweta opekata mpe 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi ma kọọ ya ozugbo
Mgbe e nyere gị ntụziaka ị na-aghọtachaghị, ịrịọ onye isi ọrụ ma ọ bụ onye ọrụ ibe gị enyemaka ma kwughachi ntụziaka ahụ iji lelee ya, tupu ịmalite ọrụ ahụ

Mgbe e nyere gị usoro oge ọrụ ma ọ bụ mgbe atụmatụ gị gbanwere, ịgụ oge shift gị ma gwa onye isi ọrụ gị na ị ga-abịa n'azụ oge, na ị na-arịa ọrịa ma ọ bụ na ị chọrọ ezumike, na-ekwu ụbọchị, oge na ihe kpatara ya, ngwa ngwa o kwere mee
Mgbe onye ahịa bịakwutere gị, ịkele onye ahịa ahụ, kwuo na ị ga-enyere aka ma kpọta onye ọrụ ọzọ mgbe ị nweghị ike inyere aka, n'ụzọ nkwanye ugwu na n'ịkọghị azịza n'ọnụ

chapters.name: Isi 1: Inweta ọrụ na ịnọ ná nchekwa

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ: ịza ajụjụ ndị a na-ajụkarị
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Zaa ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ atọ a na-ajụkarị site n'azịza dị mkpụmkpụ i doziri tupu oge.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: N'ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ, ị ga-enwe ike ịza ajụjụ ndị a na-ajụkarị dị ka "Tell me about yourself" site n'azịza dị mkpụmkpụ i doziri tupu oge, n'ahịrịokwu 2 ruo 4 doro anya nke ọ bụla, ya na otu ezi ọmụmaatụ site n'ọrụ gị ma ọ bụ ndụ gị.
Ọtụtụ ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ na-amalite n'otu ajụjụ ole na ole ahụ. Ị nwere ike idozi azịza gị tupu oge ma mụọ ikwu ha n'olu dị elu. Azịza dị mkpụmkpụ ma doo anya ka mma karịa ndị dị ogologo.
"Tell me about yourself." Jiri ọrụ gị zaa ya, ọ bụghị ndụ nzuzo gị: "I have three years of experience in a restaurant kitchen. I am fast and careful. I want to grow in food service." "Why do you want this job?" Azịza: "I like working with my hands, and this company has good training." "When can you start?" Azịza: "I can start next Monday."
Ajụjụ ndị ọzọ a na-ajụkarị: "What are your strengths?" ("I am on time and I learn fast.") "Can you work weekends?" ("Yes, I can work Saturdays.") Na njedebe, ha na-ajụkarị "Do you have any questions?" Nwee otu ajụjụ dị njikere: "What does a normal day look like?" ma ọ bụ "What are the hours?"
Ahụmahụ site n'obodo gị dị mkpa. Kwuo ya: "In Mexico I built houses for five years." Ọ bụrụ na ị ghọtaghị ajụjụ, jiri okwu ndị ị maara: "Sorry, can you repeat the question, please?"
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee azịza dị mkpụmkpụ maka ajụjụ ndị a na-ajụkarị.
- Tinye otu ezi ọmụmaatụ site n'ọrụ gị ma ọ bụ ndụ gị n'azịza ọ bụla.
- Mụọ ikwu ha n'olu dị elu ruo mgbe ị nwere ike ikwu ha n'agụghị ha.
- Dozie otu ajụjụ ị ga-ajụ na njedebe.
- Ọ bụrụ na ajụjụ gafere gị, rịọ ha ka ha kwughachi ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "Experience": ọrụ ị rụburu na mbụ.
- "Strengths": ihe ị na-eme nke ọma.
- "Interview": nzukọ ebe onye na-ewe mmadụ n'ọrụ na-ajụ gị ajụjụ iji kpebie ma ọ ga-ewe gị n'ọrụ.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- USA Learns: free English courses for adults (Sacramento County Office of Education)
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee azịza gị maka "Tell me about yourself", "Why do you want this job?" na "When can you start?" maka ọrụ ị chọrọ. Mee ka nke ọ bụla bụrụ ahịrịokwu 2 ruo 4. Gụpụta ha n'olu dị elu ugboro atọ, wee rịọ onye ibe gị ka ọ jụọ gị ajụjụ ọnụ, ma ọ bụ dekọọ olu gị ka ị na-aza ya.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịza ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ ndị a na-ajụkarị site n'azịza dị mkpụmkpụ i doziri tupu oge, na ịjụ ajụjụ na njedebe ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ.

check.q: Onye na-ajụ ajụjụ ọnụ kwuru "Tell me about yourself." Kedu azịza kacha mma?
options: "I have two years of experience cleaning offices. I am careful and on time."
"I have three children and I like soccer and my favorite food is rice."
check.why: Ọ na-ekwu maka ọrụ na ike gị n'ahịrịokwu dị mkpụmkpụ ma doo anya.

check.q: Onye na-ajụ ajụjụ ọnụ jụrụ "Do you have any questions?" Kedu ezigbo azịza?
options: "What does a normal day look like?"
check.why: Ajụjụ gbasara ọrụ ahụ na-egosi na ọ na-amasị gị.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Okwu nchekwa, akara na ịdọ aka na ntị
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kwuo ihe akara nchekwa na ịdọ aka na ntị a na-ahụkarị pụtara na ihe ị ga-eme.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị okwu nchekwa, akara na ịdọ aka na ntị a na-ahụkarị n'ebe ọrụ, ị ga-enwe ike ikwu ihe nke ọ bụla pụtara na ihe ị ga-eme, ma kọọrọ onye isi ọrụ ihe egwu ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ, ma nweta opekata mpe 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi ma kọọ ya ozugbo.
Okwu nchekwa bụ Bekee kacha mkpa n'ebe ọrụ. Bụrụ ụzọ mụta ha. Akara: "Danger" pụtara ihe egwu dị ukwuu nwere ike igbu gị ma ọ bụ merụọ gị ahụ nke ukwuu. "Caution" ma ọ bụ "Warning" pụtara kpachara anya. "Exit" bụ ụzọ ọpụpụ. "Authorized personnel only" pụtara na ọ bụ naanị ndị ọrụ nwere ikike nwere ike ịbanye. "Wet floor" pụtara na ala na-amị amị.
Ịdọ aka na ntị a na-ekwu n'ọnụ dị mkpụmkpụ ma dị ụda: "Watch out!" "Stop!" "Look out!" "Heads up!" (ihe nwere ike ịda ma ọ bụ na-abịakwute gị). Mgbe ị nụrụ otu n'ime ha, kwụsị, lee anya ma pụọ n'ebe ihe egwu ahụ dị.
Okwu maka ngwa nchekwa: "Wear your gloves." "Put on your safety glasses." "Hard hat" (okpu siri ike). "Safety vest" (uwe na-enwu gbaa ka ndị na-anya ụgbọ hụ gị). "Ear plugs" (ihe mkpuchi ntị). Onye were gị n'ọrụ na-akụziri gị ngwa maka ọrụ gị. Ọ bụrụ na ị ghọtaghị ọzụzụ ahụ, jụọ ajụjụ.
Mkparịta ụka ọmụmaatụ. Onye isi ọrụ: "Heads up! Forklift coming." Onye ọrụ: "Okay!" (laghachi azụ). Onye isi ọrụ: "Always wear your vest in this area." Onye ọrụ: "Yes. My vest, always in this area."
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "Hazard": ihe nwere ike imerụ gị ahụ, dị ka ala mmiri ma ọ bụ igwe na-agagharị.
- "Danger": okwu akara maka ihe egwu dị ukwuu nwere ike igbu gị ma ọ bụ merụọ gị ahụ nke ukwuu.
- "Caution": okwu akara pụtara kpachara anya.
- "Protective equipment": ngwa na-echebe gị, dị ka uwe aka (gloves), ugogbe anya nchekwa ma ọ bụ okpu siri ike.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- OSHA: Workers' rights (US Department of Labor)
Nwaa ugbu a: Mee kaadị okwu nchekwa maka ọrụ ị chọrọ: dee okwu ma ọ bụ akara nchekwa ise ị ga-ahụ ebe ahụ na ihe nke ọ bụla pụtara. Kwuo nke ọ bụla n'olu dị elu. Wee rịọ onye ibe gị ka ọ kpọọ ịdọ aka na ntị ("Watch out!" "Heads up!") ka ị na-egosi ihe ị ga-eme.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ikwu ihe akara nchekwa, ịdọ aka na ntị na okwu ngwa nchekwa a na-ahụkarị pụtara, na ihe ị ga-eme mgbe ị nụrụ ịdọ aka na ntị.

check.q: Onye ọrụ ibe gị tiri mkpu "Heads up!" Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Kwụsị, lee anya ma pụọ n'ebe ihe na-abịa
Tie mkpu "Heads up" laghachi ma nọrọ ebe ahụ
check.why: "Heads up!" pụtara na ihe nwere ike ịda ma ọ bụ na-abịakwute gị.

check.q: Ọnụ ụzọ nwere akara: "Authorized personnel only". Gịnị ka ọ pụtara?
options: Onye ọ bụla nwere ike ịbanye
Ọ bụ naanị ndị ọrụ nwere ikike nwere ike ịbanye
check.why: "Authorized personnel only" pụtara na ị chọrọ ikike ịbanye.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ịkọ nsogbu ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kọọrọ onye isi ọrụ gị ihe egwu ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ ozugbo.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị okwu nchekwa, akara na ịdọ aka na ntị a na-ahụkarị n'ebe ọrụ, ị ga-enwe ike ikwu ihe nke ọ bụla pụtara na ihe ị ga-eme, ma kọọrọ onye isi ọrụ ihe egwu ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ, ma nweta opekata mpe 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi ma kọọ ya ozugbo.
Ọ bụrụ na ị hụrụ ihe na-adịghị mma maka nchekwa, gwa onye isi ọrụ gị ozugbo: "Excuse me, there is a problem. There is oil on the floor in aisle 4." "This machine is making a strange noise." "The ladder is broken."
Ọ bụrụ na ị merụrụ ahụ, ọbụlagodi ntakịrị, gwa onye isi ọrụ gị n'otu ụbọchị ahụ: "I hurt my hand. I cut it on a box." "I hurt my back when I lifted that." Kwuo ebe na oge: "It happened at 10 o'clock, at the loading dock." Ọ bụrụ ihe mberede, kpọọ 911.
Na United States, OSHA (ụlọ ọrụ gọọmentị etiti maka nchekwa ọrụ) kwuru na ndị ọrụ nwere ikike, gụnyere ọzụzụ nchekwa n'asụsụ ha ghọtara, ịkọ mmerụ ahụ n'ọrụ, na ịrịọ ka e nyochaa ebe ọrụ na-adịghị nchekwa. Iwu kwuru na onye were gị n'ọrụ apụghị ịta gị ahụhụ maka iji ikike ndị a. Lee osha.gov/workers maka nkọwa zuru ezu.
Mkparịta ụka ọmụmaatụ. Onye ọrụ: "Excuse me, I need to report something. I slipped and hurt my knee." Onye isi ọrụ: "When did it happen?" Onye ọrụ: "About ten minutes ago, near the freezer." Onye isi ọrụ: "Okay, let's fill out a report."
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Kwuo "Excuse me, I need to report something."
- Kwuo ihe na-adịghị mma: ihe egwu ahụ ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ.
- Kwuo ebe na oge o mere.
- Kọọ mmerụ ahụ n'otu ụbọchị ahụ, ọbụlagodi nke nta.
- Ọ bụrụ ihe mberede, kpọọ 911.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "Report": ịgwa onye kwesịrị ekwesị maka nsogbu.
- "Injury": mmerụ n'ahụ gị, dị ka ọbelata, ọkụ gbara gị ma ọ bụ azụ merụrụ ahụ.
- "Supervisor": onye na-ahụ maka ọrụ gị.
- OSHA: Occupational Safety and Health Administration, ụlọ ọrụ gọọmentị etiti US maka nchekwa n'ebe ọrụ.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- OSHA: Workers' rights (US Department of Labor)
Nwaa ugbu a: Naanị maka omume: dee akụkọ abụọ dị mkpụmkpụ, otu gbasara ihe egwu (dịka ọmụmaatụ ala mmiri) na otu gbasara obere mmerụ ahụ i chepụtara echepụta. Nke ọ bụla na-ekwu gịnị, ebee na mgbe ole. Kwuo ha n'olu dị elu dị ka à ga-asị na ị na-agwa onye isi ọrụ gị okwu.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkọrọ onye isi ọrụ gị ihe egwu ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ, na-ekwu gịnị, ebee na mgbe ole, ma kpọọ aha ikike nchekwa gị ndị bụ isi.

check.q: Ị hụrụ ubube gbajiri agbaji n'ebe ọrụ. Gịnị ka ị ga-agwa onye isi ọrụ gị?
options: Ọ dịghị ihe; onye ọzọ ga-ahụ ya
"Excuse me, the ladder in the back room is broken."
check.why: Ịgwa onye isi ọrụ gị gịnị na ebee na-eme ka o dozie ihe egwu ahụ tupu ọ merụọ mmadụ ahụ.

check.q: Ị bepụrụ mkpịsị aka gị ntakịrị n'ebe ọrụ. Olee mgbe ị ga-akọ ya?
options: Naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ọ ka njọ
check.why: Kọọ mmerụ ahụ ọ bụla n'ọrụ n'otu ụbọchị ahụ, ọbụlagodi nke nta.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Ịrịọ enyemaka na ịlele ntụziaka
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Rịọ enyemaka ma kwughachi ntụziaka tupu ịmalite.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ntụziaka ị na-aghọtachaghị, ị ga-enwe ike ịrịọ onye isi ọrụ ma ọ bụ onye ọrụ ibe gị enyemaka ma kwughachi ntụziaka ahụ iji lelee ya, tupu ịmalite ọrụ ahụ.
N'ebe ọrụ, mperi nwere ike ịfụ oge, ego ma ọ bụ nchekwa. Ọ ka mma mgbe niile ịjụ ajụjụ karịa ịkọ n'ọnụ. Ezigbo ndị ọrụ na-ajụ ajụjụ.
Iji rịọ enyemaka: "Excuse me, can you help me?" "Can you show me how to do this?" "Where do I put these boxes?" "What should I do next?" Ọ bụrụ na ị ghọtaghị: "Sorry, can you explain that again, more slowly?"
Tupu ịmalite, kwughachi ntụziaka ahụ: "So, first I clean the tables, then I fill the napkins?" ma ọ bụ "Okay, I put the blue boxes on shelf 3. Is that right?" Onye isi ọrụ gị ga-asị "Yes" ma ọ bụ dozie ya.
Mkparịta ụka ọmụmaatụ. Onye isi ọrụ: "Please restock aisle 7 and then break down the empty boxes." Onye ọrụ: "Okay. So, first I restock aisle 7, then I break down the boxes. Where do the boxes go?" Onye isi ọrụ: "In the recycling by the back door." Onye ọrụ: "Got it. Thank you."
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Gee ntụziaka ahụ niile ntị.
- Jụọ maka ihe ọ bụla ị ghọtaghị.
- Kwughachi usoro ahụ: "So, first ..., then ...?"
- Chere "Yes" tupu ịmalite.
- Jụọ ọzọ ma ọ bụrụ na ị kwụsịrị n'ụzọ: "What should I do next?"
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "Instruction": okwu na-agwa gị otu esi arụ ọrụ.
- "Show me": mee ya n'ihu m ka m hụ otu e si eme ya.
- "Got it": ụzọ dị mkpụmkpụ isi kwuo "I understand" (aghọtara m).
Nwaa ugbu a: Rịọ onye ibe gị ma ọ bụ onye ezinụlọ gị ka o nye gị ntụziaka nwere usoro atọ na Bekee (dịka ọmụmaatụ otu esi eme sandwich ma ọ bụ apịaji uwe elu). Kwughachi ya site na "So, first ..., then ...?" tupu i mee ya. Wee gbanwee ọrụ unu.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịrịọ onye isi ọrụ ma ọ bụ onye ọrụ ibe gị enyemaka, ma kwughachi ntụziaka iji lelee ya tupu ịmalite.

check.q: Onye isi ọrụ gị nyere ntụziaka dị ogologo. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme tupu ịmalite?
options: Malite ma tụọ anya na ọ ziri ezi
Kwughachi usoro ahụ iji lelee ya
check.why: Ịkwughachi usoro ahụ na-ejide mperi tupu ịmalite.

check.q: Ị maghị otu esi eji igwe ọhụrụ ahụ. Gịnị ka ị ga-ekwu?
options: "Can you show me how to do this?"
Ọ dịghị ihe; nwaa ya n'agbanyeghị
check.why: "Can you show me?" na-arịọ enyemaka n'ụzọ nchekwa ma doo anya.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Usoro oge: shift, ịbịa n'azụ oge, ụbọchị ọrịa na ezumike
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Gụọ oge shift gị ma gwa onye isi ọrụ gị na ị ga-abịa n'azụ oge, na ị na-arịa ọrịa ma ọ bụ na ị chọrọ ezumike.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị usoro oge ọrụ ma ọ bụ mgbe atụmatụ gị gbanwere, ị ga-enwe ike ịgụ oge shift gị ma gwa onye isi ọrụ gị na ị ga-abịa n'azụ oge, na ị na-arịa ọrịa ma ọ bụ na ị chọrọ ezumike, na-ekwu ụbọchị, oge na ihe kpatara ya, ngwa ngwa o kwere mee.
Shift bụ oge ị na-arụ ọrụ, dịka ọmụmaatụ "Monday, 7 a.m. to 3:30 p.m." "a.m." bụ ụtụtụ (tupu elekere 12 ehihie) ma "p.m." bụ ehihie na abalị. Usoro oge gị nwekwara ike ikwu "OFF" maka ụbọchị ị na-anaghị arụ ọrụ.
Ọ bụrụ na ị ga-abịa n'azụ oge, gwa onye isi ọrụ gị tupu shift gị: "Hi, this is Carlos. I'm sorry, my bus is late. I will be about 20 minutes late." Ọ bụrụ na ị na-arịa ọrịa: "Hi, this is Carlos. I'm sick today and I can't come in. I'm sorry." Onye ọ bụla na-ewe mmadụ n'ọrụ nwere iwu nke ya maka ịkpọ oku, ya mere lelee akwụkwọ iwu (handbook) gị ma ọ bụ jụọ onye isi ọrụ gị otu na mgbe ị ga-agwa ha.
Iji rịọ ezumike, rịọọ ya n'oge, ihu na ihu ma ọ bụ n'ederede: "Can I have Friday the 14th off? I have an appointment." Iji gbanwee shift gị na onye ọrụ ibe gị: "Can I switch shifts with Maria on Saturday?"
Ozi ederede ọmụmaatụ: "Hi Ms. Johnson, this is Carlos from the morning shift. I am sick today and cannot come in. I'm sorry. I will let you know about tomorrow."
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Gụọ usoro oge gị: ụbọchị, oge mmalite na oge njedebe.
- Ịbịa n'azụ oge ma ọ bụ ọrịa: gwa onye isi ọrụ gị tupu shift gị.
- Kwuo onye ị bụ, ihe na-adịghị mma na mgbe ị ga-abịa.
- Rịọ ezumike n'oge, ma kwuo ụbọchị ya.
- Gbasoo iwu onye were gị n'ọrụ maka ịkpọ oku.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "Shift": awa ị na-arụ ọrụ n'otu ụbọchị.
- "Call in sick": ịgwa onye were gị n'ọrụ na ị na-arịa ọrịa ma ị nweghị ike ịrụ ọrụ.
- "Time off": ụbọchị ị rịọrọ ka ị ghara ịrụ ọrụ.
- "Switch shifts": ịgbanwe oge ọrụ gị na onye ọrụ ibe gị.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee ozi abụọ nye onye isi ọrụ nwere aha i chepụtara echepụta: otu iji kwuo na ị ga-abịa n'azụ oge nkeji 15, na otu iji kọọ na ị na-arịa ọrịa. Nke ọ bụla na-ekwu onye ị bụ, ihe na-adịghị mma na mgbe ị ga-abịa. Gụpụta ha n'olu dị elu dị ka oku ekwentị.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịgụ oge shift gị, ma gwa onye isi ọrụ gị nke ọma na ị ga-abịa n'azụ oge, na ị na-arịa ọrịa ma ọ bụ na ị chọrọ ezumike.

check.q: Usoro oge gị kwuru "Tuesday 2 p.m. - 10 p.m." Olee mgbe ị ga-amalite ọrụ?
check.why: "p.m." pụtara ehihie ma ọ bụ abalị, ya mere 2 p.m. bụ elekere 2 n'ehihie.

check.q: Bọs gị na-egbu oge ma ị ga-atụfu mmalite shift gị. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Gwa onye isi ọrụ gị tupu shift gị amalite
Ekwula ihe ọ bụla ma bịa n'azụ oge
check.why: Ịgwa onye isi ọrụ gị n'oge na-egosi nkwanye ugwu ma na-enyere ya aka ịhazi ihe.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Ịgwa ndị ahịa okwu
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kelee onye ahịa, kwuo na ị ga-enyere aka ma kpọta onye ọrụ ọzọ mgbe ị nweghị ike inyere aka.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe onye ahịa bịakwutere gị, ị ga-enwe ike ịkele onye ahịa ahụ, kwuo na ị ga-enyere aka ma kpọta onye ọrụ ọzọ mgbe ị nweghị ike inyere aka, n'ụzọ nkwanye ugwu na n'ịkọghị azịza n'ọnụ.
Ndị ahịa na-enwe mmasị n'ndị ọrụ nwere obi ọma ma na-ekwu okwu doro anya. Kelee ha: "Hi, welcome!" ma ọ bụ "Good morning." Kwuo na ị ga-enyere aka: "Can I help you find something?" "What can I get for you?"
Ọ bụrụ na ị maara azịza ya, mee ka ọ dị mkpụmkpụ: "Yes, it's in aisle 9." "It comes with fries." Ọ bụrụ na ị maghị, akọla n'ọnụ mgbe ọ bụla. Kwuo: "Let me check for you." ma ọ bụ "One moment, please. I'll get my manager."
Ọ bụrụ na onye ahịa na-ekwu okwu ngwa ngwa: "Sorry, could you say that again, please?" Ọ bụrụ na iwe na-ewe ha, nọrọ jụụ ma kwanyere ha ugwu: "I'm sorry about that. Let me get someone who can help." Mechie ya na: "Have a nice day!"
Mkparịta ụka ọmụmaatụ. Onye ọrụ: "Hi, welcome! Can I help you find something?" Onye ahịa: "Do you have this jacket in a large?" Onye ọrụ: "Let me check for you. One moment, please." (na-elele) "Yes, here you go." Onye ahịa: "Thanks!" Onye ọrụ: "You're welcome. Have a nice day!"
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Kelee: "Hi, welcome!"
- Kwuo na ị ga-enyere aka: "Can I help you find something?"
- Zaa nkenke ma ọ bụrụ na ị maara.
- Ọ bụrụ na ị maghị: "Let me check for you." ma ọ bụ kpọta onye manager.
- Mechie: "Have a nice day!"
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- "Customer": onye na-azụ ma ọ bụ na-eji ihe azụmahịa na-ere.
- "Manager": onye na-ahụ maka ụlọ ahịa ma ọ bụ otu ndị ọrụ.
- "Let me check": ụzọ nkwanye ugwu isi kwuo na ị ga-achọta azịza ya.
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: dee edemede Bekee Ebe Ọrụ gị maka ọrụ ị chọrọ: azịza gị maka "Tell me about yourself", azịza ajụjụ ọnụ abụọ ọzọ, okwu nchekwa atọ na ihe ha pụtara, ozi ọrịa ma ọ bụ ịbịa n'azụ oge, na okwu abụọ maka onye ahịa ma ọ bụ maka ịrịọ onye ọrụ ibe gị enyemaka. Mụọ ikwu ya n'olu dị elu ma ọ bụ n'egwuregwu ọrụ, ma dekọọ olu gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ike.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkele onye ahịa, ikwu na ị ga-enyere aka, na ịkpọta onye kwesịrị ekwesị mgbe ị maghị azịza ya.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Azịza ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ Azịza adịghị, dị ogologo nke ukwuu, ma ọ bụ gbasara ndụ nzuzo kama ọrụ. "Tell me about yourself" na azịza abụọ ọzọ, nke ọ bụla ahịrịokwu 2 ruo 4 doro anya ya na otu ezi ọmụmaatụ. Na-ekwu ha n'olu dị elu n'agụghị ha ma tinye ajụjụ a ga-ajụ na njedebe. Okwu nchekwa Okwu erughị atọ, ma ọ bụ nkọwa ha ezighi ezi. Okwu ma ọ bụ akara nchekwa atọ maka ọrụ ahụ, nke ọ bụla ya na nkọwa ziri ezi. Na-egosikwa otu esi akọ ihe egwu ma ọ bụ mmerụ ahụ: gịnị, ebee na mgbe ole. Ịrịọ enyemaka Enweghị okwu maka ịrịọ enyemaka, ma ọ bụ ụzọ isi lelee ntụziaka. Otu okwu maka ịrịọ enyemaka na otu ahịrịokwu na-akwughachi ntụziaka. Na-eji ha nke ọma n'egwuregwu ọrụ ya na onye ibe ya. Ozi n'azụ oge ma ọ bụ ọrịa Enweghị onye ị bụ, ihe na-adịghị mma ma ọ bụ mgbe ị ga-abịa. Ozi doro anya, nwere nkwanye ugwu, ya na aha, ihe kpatara ya na oge. Na-ekwukwa otu onye were ya n'ọrụ si chọọ ka a kpọọ oku (handbook ma ọ bụ onye isi ọrụ). Okwu maka ndị ahịa Enweghị okwu maka ndị ahịa, ma ọ bụ okwu ndị ahụ enweghị nkwanye ugwu. Ekele ya na ikwu na ị ga-enyere aka, na okwu maka mgbe ị maghị. Na-ejikwa nkwanye ugwu emeso onye ahịa iwe na-ewe n'egwuregwu ọrụ. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, mụọ akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.

check.q: Onye ahịa jụrụ ajụjụ ma ị maghị azịza ya. Gịnị ka ị ga-ekwu?
check.why: Ịlele ma ọ bụ ịkpọta manager na-egosi nkwanye ugwu ma na-enye onye ahịa ezi azịza.

check.q: Onye ahịa bịakwutere gị. Kedu ezigbo ihe mbụ ị ga-ekwu?
options: "Hi, welcome! Can I help you find something?"
check.why: Ekele na ikwu na ị ga-enyere aka na-amalite mkparịta ụka nke ọma.
